newsitem.title: USA: Peres warns against fundamentalism. [CORRECTED 5:16 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Peres warns against fundamentalism. [CORRECTED 5:16 GMT]

text.p: Former Israeli Prime Minister Shimon Peres said on Tuesday the Middle East was being threatened by a "fundamentalistic movement" led by Iran.
Peres, in a speech at Yale University, urged Jews, Moslems and Christians to unite against such fundamentalism.

The Middle East was threatened by "a fundamentalistic movement that tries to shake up and endanger practically every existing system in the Arab world. And its headquarters are today in a single country -- in Iran," (corrects) Peres said.
"This movement not only has a sworn commitment to a religious way, but it also uses terror and threats and arms, and is trying to acquire a nuclear capacity."
He added: "We have to regroup all the parties who are worried about fundamentalism, whether they are Moslems or Christians or Jewish."
